title: Hostinger coupon SONAR20: 20% off, where to enter the code and what it covers
seoTitle: Hostinger Coupon SONAR20 2026: 20% Off First Period
description: The Hostinger coupon SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of any plan, monthly or annual, for new or existing customers. See where to enter the code, what it covers and what changes at renewal.
metaDescription: Hostinger coupon SONAR20: 20% off the first period of a monthly or annual plan, for new or existing customers. See where to enter the code in the cart and the renewal price.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, there is a coupon: the code **SONAR20** gives 20% off the first period of any [Hostinger](/en/coupons/hostinger) plan, monthly or annual, for new or existing customers. Enter the code in the cart, or come in through this article's link. We have not tested renewal; check the renewal price in the cart. The math is below.

contentSections.heading: What SONAR20 covers
paragraphs: SONAR20 covers all plans, monthly and annual, and works for existing Hostinger customers too. In a test on October 29, 2026, on the global site in US dollars, the 48-month Startup plan went from US$383.52 to US$306.82 with the code in the cart: the 20% came off the Black Friday price. That plan did not accept the referral link, and the code worked on its own.
The referral link keeps its own rules: plans of 12 months or more, for new customers. In every other case, use the code. We do not cite codes from other sites.

contentSections.heading: Where to enter the code
paragraphs: Choose the plan and the period and go to the cart. In the order summary, click “Have a coupon code?”, paste **SONAR20** and apply it. The 20% shows up in the first-period total before you pay. The plans are on the [Hostinger page on this site](/en/coupons/hostinger).

contentSections.heading: Our experience with Hostinger
paragraphs: This site runs on Hostinger. Bruno, who also signs this text, has been a customer since 2024, for more than 24 months: Business web hosting, a KVM 2 VPS, Business email and domains, all with automatic renewal. Every time there was a problem, support solved it, mainly through the AI agent, and he has never seen the service go down.
That is his account, with his use. The code rules in this text come from Hostinger's pages and from the test above, not from his experience.

contentSections.heading: Monthly, annual and existing customers
paragraphs: SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period on monthly or annual plans, for new and existing customers. That covers web hosting, VPS and the other plans; on a domain on its own, check in the cart whether the discount appears. An existing customer uses the code on a new plan. The renewal of a plan you already have follows the price in your control panel.

contentSections.heading: Renewal: the price after the first period
paragraphs: After the first period, the renewal price is shown below each plan's card on the pricing page. We have not tested renewal with SONAR20; check the renewal price in the cart. The page says you can change the billing period or cancel at any time before renewal.

To turn off automatic renewal, and to see what customers say about charges they did not expect, read the [Hostinger on Trustpilot article](/en/reviews/hostinger-trustpilot-reviews), which has the step by step from Hostinger's help center.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
bullets: Choose the plan and the period, and go to the cart.
Enter SONAR20 in the coupon field and apply it.
Check that the 20% appears on the first-period total and that the renewal price is listed.
If the cart price differs from what you saw elsewhere, the cart price is the one that counts. Prices change with the campaign and with your region.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does Hostinger have a coupon? Yes: the code SONAR20 gives 20% off the first period of any plan, monthly or annual.
Where do I enter the Hostinger coupon? In the cart, in the coupon field (“Have a coupon code?” on the global site). Paste SONAR20 and apply it before you pay.
Does SONAR20 work for existing customers? Yes, on a new plan. The renewal of a plan you already have follows the price in your control panel.
Does the coupon discount the renewal? We have not tested it. Check the renewal price in the cart before you pay.
Does SONAR20 work on Black Friday? Yes: in the test on October 29, 2026, on the global site, the 20% came off the campaign price of the 48-month Startup plan.

contentSections.heading: Transparency note
paragraphs: Purchases with the SONAR20 code or through the link may earn Bruno a commission, at no extra cost to you. This site runs on Hostinger, and Bruno has been a customer since 2024. The referral page and the programme terms were read on October 19, 2026; the code test was run on October 29, 2026. Prices and campaigns change, and Hostinger can change them at any time.
